effects: Takes exactly `assets` EURC from the signer into the vault (VaultV2.enter: safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)).
Mints gteurcc shares, worth previewDeposit(assets), to `onBehalf`. The share price comes from storage.
formats.shown: Deposit 0.1 EURC for 0x…dEaD, with the EURC amount, a constant share ticker 'gteurcc' and the share recipient as fields.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted is not shown; it comes from the vault's share price in storage.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit(): `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets);`. No shares or minShares parameter exists in calldata. The descriptor's 'Share ticker' field shows only the constant 'gteurcc'.
findings.fix: Nothing a descriptor can do. You could relabel the ticker field 'Receive shares in' so its meaning is plain.

findings.title: deposit: the 'Share ticker' field is a bare constant, and its role is unclear on its own.
findings.fix: Use a label such as 'Shares received (token)', or drop the field and add 'into gteurcc vault' to the intent.

cases.notes: 0.1 EURC out to the vault is shown exactly. The shares went to 0xdead, which is shown. The reader understood that the shares are lost.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns previewWithdraw(assets) gteurcc shares (rounded up) from `onBehalf`. The amount depends on the share price in storage.
When the signer is not `onBehalf`, it spends that many shares of onBehalf's share allowance to the signer.
Sends exactly `assets` EURC from the vault to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly 900 EURC to the receiver, with the receiver and the share owner as fields.

findings.title: withdraw: the gteurcc shares burned from the owner are not shown; the amount is derived from storage.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw(): `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets);`, then exit(): `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. In case 2, 898.839033179660570960 gteurcc left the signer, and no field states it.
findings.fix: Nothing a descriptor can do. The 'Owner' field already names whose shares are burned.

cases.notes: The 900 EURC arriving at the signer is exact. The share burn of 898.84 gteurcc is not stated; the reader inferred that shares worth 900 EURC leave but did not know the amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` gteurcc from `onBehalf`. When the signer is not `onBehalf`, it spends that much of onBehalf's share allowance to the signer.
Sends previewRedeem(shares) EURC from the vault to `receiver`. The amount depends on the share price in storage, and there is no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem 134953.8 gteurcc to the receiver, with the share amount, the receiver and the owner as fields; nothing names the asset received.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never says the signer receives EURC; only the shares are named.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit(): `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);`. In case 3 the signer received 135028.028024 EURC. The descriptor's redeem fields are shares, receiver and onBehalf only; the mint format has a constant 'Deposit asset: EURC' field, but redeem has nothing like it. The blind reader wrote: 'the amount and which token are not shown'.
findings.fix: Add a field `{"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}` and change the intent to 'Redeem {#.shares} for EURC to {#.receiver}'.

findings.title: redeem: the EURC amount received is not shown and has no minimum; it comes from the share price in storage.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem(): `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);`. No minAssets parameter. In case 3 the signer received 135028.028024 EURC, which is not on screen.
findings.fix: Nothing a descriptor can do for the amount.

cases.notes: The 134953.81 gteurcc out is shown exactly. The 135028.03 EURC arriving at the signer has neither asset nor amount on screen; the reader knew only that 'some underlying asset' comes back.

effects: Takes previewMint(shares) EURC (rounded up) from the signer into the vault. The amount depends on the share price in storage, and the only limit is the signer's approval.
formats.shown: Mint 0.9 gteurcc for 0x…dEaD, with a constant 'Deposit asset: EURC' field and no EURC amount.

findings.title: mint: the EURC amount taken from the signer is not shown; it is computed from the share price in storage.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol mint(): `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`, and enter(): `safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)`. In case 1, 0.907906 EURC left the signer, and the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: EURC'. There is no maxAssets parameter in calldata.
findings.fix: Nothing a descriptor can do for the amount.

findings.title: mint: the intent 'Mint {shares} for {onBehalf}' does not say the signer pays EURC.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint `interpolatedIntent: "Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}"`. Paying EURC appears only as a separate raw field, 'Deposit asset: EURC'.

cases.notes: The signer paid 0.907906 EURC. The screen names EURC but gives no amount; the reader knew EURC leaves but not how much.
